items.label: Rounded corners
items.description: Sets how round cards and buttons are.

items.label: Background pattern
items.description: Adds a pattern behind the page.

items.label: Inset panels
items.description: Shows the sidebar and page as rounded panels on a frame. Floating page blends the sidebar into the frame.

items.label: Borders
items.description: Adds borders under the top bar and around the budget and report cards.

items.label: Privacy style
items.description: How amounts look while privacy mode hides them.

items.label: Modern titlebar
items.description: Restyles the top bar and adds a theme menu.

items.label: Modern headers
items.description: Restyles the Budget and Reports page headers.

items.label: Category filter
items.description: Filters the budget to categories that need attention or are on track.

items.label: Modern account toolbar
items.description: Restyles the account page's buttons and search.

items.label: Modern toasts
items.description: Restyles notifications as compact cards.

items.label: Live sidebar
items.description: Replaces Actual's sidebar with one that has live balances, account groups and shortcuts.
items.writes: Renames an account, runs its bank sync, or edits account groups when you do so from the sidebar.

items.label: Customize sidebar
items.description: Opens the sidebar's layout, density, search and shortcut settings.

items.label: Live sidebar layout
items.description: A standard sidebar, or an icon bar with a separate accounts panel.

items.label: Sidebar density
items.description: Sets the spacing in the live sidebar.

items.label: Sidebar search
items.description: Filters accounts, categories and pages.

items.label: Sidebar shortcuts
items.description: Pins links and tools to the sidebar.

items.label: Account icon picker
items.description: Adds an emoji or website icon to each account.

items.label: Account group totals
items.description: Shows each group's combined balance beside its name.

items.label: Show closed accounts
items.description: Lists closed accounts in their own section at the bottom.

items.label: Color negative balances
items.description: Shows negative account balances in red.

items.label: Budget row height
items.description: Sets how tall each budget row is.

items.label: Month cards
items.description: The cards above your budget.
items.writes: Full runs budget templates in tracking mode; envelope mode can also fund targets or cover overspending from To Budget.

items.label: Progress rings
items.description: Adds a progress ring beside each balance. Hover it for spending details.

items.label: Balance status pills
items.description: Adds an icon to each balance's status, so it doesn't rely on color alone.

items.label: Flag overspent groups
items.description: Shows how many categories are overspent beside each group's name.

items.label: Category color dots
items.description: Gives each category a colored dot in the budget and transactions.

items.label: Category emoji picker
items.description: Adds an emoji or image to each category.
items.writes: Adds the emoji you pick to the category's name.

items.label: Quiet category icons
items.description: Hides the template and notes icons until you hover. Notes icons stay where there are notes.

items.label: Budget insights
items.description: Shows the month's summary, templates and plan in a side panel.
items.writes: Applies the month's budget templates when you click Apply.

items.label: Template bars
items.description: Shows how funded each category's template is.

items.label: Striped rows
items.description: Shades every other row in the transaction table.

items.label: Color transactions
items.description: Colors payments, deposits and upcoming transactions.

items.label: Row status
items.description: Marks new, uncategorized and reconciled transactions.

items.label: Tag styling
items.description: Shows #tags as colored pills.

items.label: Resizable columns
items.description: Drag a column's edge in the transaction table to resize it.

items.label: Daily available
items.description: Shows how much an account can spend per day for the rest of the month.

items.label: Modern reconcile
items.description: Reconciles in a side panel that tracks the difference as you clear transactions.
items.writes: Clears transactions you tick, adds an adjustment if you ask, and locks them when you finish.

items.label: Sync recap
items.description: Lists what each bank sync or import added, for you to review.
items.writes: Sets a transaction's category when you pick one in the recap.

items.label: Transaction inspector
items.description: Shows the selected transaction's payee history, rules and schedule in a side panel.

items.label: Spending calendar
items.description: Adds a calendar of daily spending to the sidebar.

items.label: Income breakdown widget
items.description: Adds an income breakdown chart to the reports' widget menu.

items.label: Header
items.description: Gives page headers a native look.

items.label: Tab bar
items.description: Replaces the slide-up menu with a tab bar, and puts the other pages under More.

items.label: Cards
items.description: Shows budget groups, accounts and reports as rounded cards or flush sections.

items.label: Accounts
items.description: Lists accounts in your sidebar groups, with their icons and group totals.

items.label: Budget banners
items.description: Restyles the overspent and uncategorized banners as cards.

items.label: Modals as sheets
items.description: Opens pop-ups as sheets from the bottom that you swipe down to close.

items.label: Transaction list
items.description: Shows transactions as a native list with date headings.

items.label: Snackbar toasts
items.description: Shows notifications as snackbars above the tab bar.

items.label: Page transitions
items.description: How each page appears as you move between them.
